newsitem.title: IRAN: Force 4.2 quake hits Iran, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Force 4.2 quake hits Iran, no casualties reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.2 on the Richter scale jolted Iran's northwestern province of East Azerbaijan on Wednesday, but there was no immediate word on casualties, the official news agency IRNA said.
The new quake was the third to hit Iran since a force 7.1 one devastated Iran's eastern provinces on Saturday killing 1,560 people and leaving 50,000 homeless.
IRNA, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the epicentre of the new quake was 100 km (60 miles) northeast of the town of Tabriz.
Earthquakes of force four or more are powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
